craft_notes: Sthāyin: sleep-edge (the most ordinary door — hovering-on-sleep). Rows: row 3 (perished→shines). Close: shines (prakāśate — the shining-verb repeats across this block: form, self-form, Goddess — refrain). Rejected: 'yoga-nidrā' — killed: sleep kept plain; 'transitional state' — killed: outer-range-perished kept (the threshold IS the practice).

lines: In not-yet-come, in sleep, outer range perished:
that state to be gone by mind — supreme Goddess shines.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anāgatāyāṃ nidrāyām praṇaṣṭe bāhyagocare | sāvasthā manasā gamyā parā devī prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: What state comes before sleep? → At sleep's outer range, going by mind into that state, the supreme goddess shines.
c1_essence: Sleep's outer range perished: supreme goddess shines.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
